# Third-party map components

SMSWeb bundles the following open-source components and data for offline map
rendering:

- MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0 — BSD-3-Clause.
- PMTiles JS 3.2.0 — BSD-3-Clause.
- Protomaps Basemaps 5.0.0 styles — BSD-3-Clause; map design CC0.
- Protomaps Basemaps Assets fonts and sprites. Noto Sans fonts are distributed
  under the SIL Open Font License.
- Protomaps Basemap vector tiles derived from OpenStreetMap and Natural Earth.
  OpenStreetMap-derived data is distributed under the Open Database License.

The application displays `© OpenStreetMap contributors · Protomaps` in the map
attribution control. Project and license details:

- https://maplibre.org/
- https://github.com/protomaps/PMTiles
- https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps
- https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps-assets
- https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
